title: Checkpoint: The Five Good Emperors
objective: After this level you can explain the era of the Five Good Emperors, ending with Marcus Aurelius.
summary: From 96 to 180 CE, emperors chosen by adoption gave Rome its steadiest era. Marcus Aurelius passed power to his son Commodus, and it ended.

cards.headline: Chapter 6 finale. Five emperors in a row who ruled well. Then it ended.
cards.body: How Rome found good rulers for most of a century, and how it lost them.

cards.headline: Choosing the best
cards.body: Nerva, Trajan, Hadrian, Antoninus Pius and Marcus Aurelius, who ruled from 96 to 180 CE, are known as the Five Good Emperors. None of the first four left a surviving son, so each passed power to an adopted adult heir. The historian Edward Gibbon called it the time when the human race was most happy and prosperous.

cards.headline: The philosopher emperor
cards.body: Marcus Aurelius, a Stoic philosopher, wrote his private reflections, the Meditations, while on campaign. A deadly epidemic, the Antonine Plague, swept the empire from about 165 CE. Marcus was succeeded by his own son Commodus, whose disastrous reign ended the era.

cards.headline: Chapter 6 complete
learned: The Five Good Emperors ruled 96 to 180 CE
The first four chose heirs by adoption
His son Commodus ended the era

questions.prompt: Who was the last of the Five Good Emperors?

options.label: Nerva
Commodus
options.rationale: He was Marcus’s son, and ended the era.

options.label: Marcus Aurelius
Domitian

questions.explanation: Marcus Aurelius, the philosopher emperor, was the last of the five.

questions.prompt: Under which emperor did the empire reach its greatest extent?

options.label: Augustus
Hadrian
Claudius
options.rationale: He added Britain, but it grew later.

options.label: Trajan

questions.explanation: Under Trajan the empire reached its greatest extent, in 117 CE.

questions.prompt: How did the first four Good Emperors choose their heirs?

options.label: By letting the army vote
By passing power to their eldest son
By adopting a capable adult
By asking the Senate to hold elections

questions.explanation: None had a surviving son, so each adopted a capable adult as heir.

questions.prompt: Why does Commodus mark the end of the era?

options.label: He was the first emperor from outside Italy
A son inherited, not a chosen adult
He moved the capital away from Rome
He was elected by the Praetorian Guard

questions.explanation: Marcus Aurelius passed power to his own son, and Commodus’ disastrous reign broke the pattern of adoption.

questions.prompt: Chapter 6 recap: when is the Pax Romana usually said to end?

options.label: With the Great Fire of Rome in 64 CE
With the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE
With Hadrian’s Wall being built in 122 CE
With Marcus Aurelius’ death in 180 CE

questions.explanation: The Pax Romana is usually dated from 27 BCE to 180 CE, when Marcus Aurelius died.
